unit.name: artifact verification rejects stale source, altered bundles and inconsistent release metadata
nested shapes fail with actionable paths, not runtime property errors
known entities require matching domains without requiring HA to load them
finite bounds, precision, labels and supported enums are validated
valid zero settings and unknown extensions survive without input or preset mutation
custom sensors need a name and complete scale, with explicit linear support
zones reject duplicate, unordered, mismatched and nonfinite breakpoints
preset endpoint overrides preserve interior thresholds and interpolate their new ends
textual band boundaries agree with the scale and identify out-of-range values
entity suggestions follow registry device identity and retain existing helpers
mixed-device configurations do not silently choose a device
attribute sources allow other domains while explicit scope preserves existing selections
nested option patches preserve extensions, explicit blanks and numeric zero without mutating input
device options preserve an explicit offline device and prefer user labels
states require complete finite decimal numbers, while zero remains valid
number metadata rejects malformed bounds/steps and out-of-range reports
adjacent steps respect nonzero minima, off-grid reports and unreachable maxima
fractional steps send stable decimal values and stop at bounds
explicit attribute sources preserve zero and never fall back to state
availability conditions distinguish known disabled from unknown state
sample timestamps require timezone and valid calendar/time fields
freshness requires explicit sample time and expires at the configured deadline
separate sample-time entity supports unchanged samples without using transport age
source, availability, freshness and history settings validate known fields
release notes select an exact version, not adjacent entries
missing or empty notes block publication
the four water-care presets have finite ordered scales
piecewise interpolation agrees at each segment midpoint
extreme finite readings clamp to the ends instead of escaping the card
custom scales without zones use their own bounds
